explanation: Sputnik 1 was a polished metal ball about 58 cm across whose radio beeps anyone with a suitable receiver could pick up. It circled Earth for about three months.

claims.text: Sputnik 1, launched by the Soviet Union in October 1957, was the first artificial satellite.
Explorer 1 (1958), Vostok 1 (1961) and Telstar 1 (1962) all came after Sputnik 1.
Sputnik 1 was a polished metal sphere about 58 cm in diameter.
Sputnik's radio signals could be picked up by amateur radio operators around the world.
Sputnik 1 stayed in orbit for about three months, until January 1958.
